verses.englishText: Woe to those who give less [than due],[1878]
verses.footnotes: [1878] i.e., those who cheat people by giving them less than what they paid for when weighing or measuring - an amount so little as to hardly be noticed.

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
verses.englishText: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
Do they not think that they will be resurrected
For a tremendous Day -
The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

verses.arabicText: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
verses.englishText: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
It is [their destination[1879] recorded in] a register inscribed.
Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
Who deny the Day of Recompense.

verses.arabicText: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.englishText: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.

verses.arabicText: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.englishText: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

verses.arabicText: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.englishText: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.[1880]

verses.arabicText: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
verses.englishText: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.[1881]
verses.footnotes: [1881] i.e., they will not be able to see Him.

verses.englishText: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.englishText: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."

verses.arabicText: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
verses.englishText: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn.
And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn?
It is [their destination[1882] recorded in] a register inscribed
Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allāh].
Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
On adorned couches, observing.
You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
They will be given to drink [pure] wine[1883] [which was] sealed.
verses.footnotes: [1883] Which is delicious and does not intoxicate.

verses.arabicText: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
verses.englishText: The last of it[1884] is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
And its mixture is of Tasneem,[1885]
verses.footnotes: [1885] The highest spring in Paradise and the most favored drink of its inhabitants.

verses.englishText: A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.englishText: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

verses.arabicText: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
verses.englishText: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.

verses.arabicText: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
verses.englishText: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

verses.arabicText: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.englishText: So Today[1886] those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
On adorned couches, observing.

verses.arabicText: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.englishText: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
